Package com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces

Class PhoneNumbersNamespace

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces.PhoneNumbersNamespace
public class PhoneNumbersNamespace extends Object
REST namespace for phone number management.

Supports the standard CRUD surface plus typed helpers for binding an inbound call to a handler (SWML webhook, cXML webhook, AI agent, call flow, RELAY application/topic). The binding model is: set call_handler + the handler-specific companion field on the phone number; the server auto-materializes the matching Fabric resource. See PhoneCallHandler for the enum and rest/docs/phone-binding.md for the full model.

    • setSwmlWebhook

      public Map<String,Object> setSwmlWebhook(String id, String url)
      Route inbound calls on this phone number to an SWML webhook URL.

      Your backend returns an SWML document per call. The server auto-creates a swml_webhook Fabric resource keyed off this URL.

      Parameters:
      id - phone number SID
      url - SWML endpoint the server should fetch per call
      Returns:
      the updated phone number representation

    • setCxmlWebhook

      public Map<String,Object> setCxmlWebhook(String id, String url)
      Route inbound calls to a cXML (Twilio-compat / LAML) webhook.

      Despite the wire value laml_webhooks being plural, this creates a single cxml_webhook Fabric resource.

      Parameters:

      url - primary cXML endpoint
